newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Wagga Wagga to sell gas assets.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Wagga Wagga to sell gas assets.

text.p: The inland city of Wagga Wagga in the Australian state of New South Wales said on Sunday it planned to sell its natural gas distribution system.

"The council saw ... that it was no longer in the best interest of the people of Wagga Wagga to retain a business which would have depreciated in value unless substantial ratepayers' funds were used to, not only defend market share, but also to expand into other markets," Wagga Wagga Mayor Peter Dale said.
The assets include a 524 kilometre gas restriculation system which supplies 1.5 petajoules of gas a year to 13,500 idustrial, commercial and domestic users,
The council decided to sell the assets after McIntosh Corporate Ltd provided a valuation of the natural gas and Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) operations, Dale said.
Wagga Wagga had not decided yet whether to sell its LPG assets, he said.
Dale told Reuters he could not say how much the assets had been valued at.
"But I can say we've been strongly approached by the larger energy concerns in Australia," Dale said.
Australia's largest gas concerns include the Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd, Australian Gas Light Co Ltd and Santos Ltd.
